title.narrative: Preparatory Study for Ndola Project Group

description.narrative: The project's core objective is to empower young adults, fostering their self-confidence, self-reliance, and positive contribution to society. It places a strong emphasis on inclusivity, democracy, and collaboration. The main focus is on providing education, training, leadership development, and encouraging community service and volunteerism. The preparatory study aims to create a Hub in Zambia, addressing youth unemployment, skill development, and creating safe spaces for youth to develop their skills and talents. The project targets unemployed youth in Zambia, offering workshops, mentorship, and the establishment of a youth caf� for skill development and fellowship. The project will engage volunteers, strengthen volunteer culture, and promote gender equality within the partner organization. It also intends to collaborate with local authorities to supplement government efforts and build community relationships. With the first visit, partners were identified and relationships established. This upcoming visit will focus on in depth discussion on the nature and specific requirements of the project.
